watchdog_source: user report: no motor command within 60 ms activates failsafe runaway brakes
commissioning_command_change_source: Operator requested 0.05 on 2026-09-12; commands above the original 0.04 minimum are limited to two-second supervised trials. This is authorization, not a measured speed or stopping qualification.
note: Timing and commissioning limits are software policy, not measured hardware capability. Host write times do not prove firmware receipt or physical stopping.
wire_polarity_basis: Operator 2026-09-13: the rig travels the intended way only on negative wire commands, so the motor wiring is inverted relative to the planner's sign convention. Applied at the transport, not in planning: rig.reverse_enabled would reverse the planned path through the world and made the shot unsolvable. Plans stay in logical forward units; the adapter emits what the hardware needs. Physical polarity is still unverified on hardware.
